connecting_derivation: G2 supplies the actual full-three D210 fiber surface A/L, full geometric End=B in the nonCM branch, all conjugate Hom over the same L, and normalizer same-Hodge lattice isogenies. V16 lines8226–8255 specifically make these maps B-linear in direction sigma A -> A, with mu_1=1 and finite choices inflated from Gal(L/Q); F-linear Skolem-Noether maps alone are not used. G3 changes only the rational-parameter support bound: all five primitive forms, including v, give rad(D_L)|R and good reduction of that same A/L away210. Therefore M0 uses these identical A,L,B,mu objects and R=B_SM_S(a) with no extra field. M2 then invokes its separately reviewed M1 cochain to form rho and, on G_Lprime, mu=a=b=1 gives the actual V_l(A); Faltings, deRham and oddness apply to this A. This new edge does not accept M1 or all M2-M3 or the G4 height/CM supplier.
